unit_of_observation: one fictional student in a multisite randomized replication
assignment_mechanism: exact 1:1 randomized assignment within each of eight site-by-baseline-distress cells after a deterministic-seed shuffle
target_estimands: marginal intention-to-treat risk difference and risk ratio in the recruited cohort and in an externally specified target population
warning: This is not a validated model of student wellbeing, missingness, self-report, or transport. The blinded outcome is intentionally incomplete and the self-report measure intentionally uses assignment-dependent classification parameters.
missing_value_code: empty blinded_improvement exactly when blinded_outcome_observed equals 0; no other field is missing

variables.name: baseline_high_distress
variables.role: baseline randomization, missingness, and effect-modification cell
variables.unit: 1 high; 0 lower distress on a fictional screen

variables.name: program_assignment
variables.time: after baseline and before the program

variables.name: blinded_outcome_observed
variables.role: observation indicator for the primary blinded assessment

variables.name: blinded_improvement
variables.role: primary outcome assessed by a blinded evaluator
variables.unit: 1 clinically meaningful improvement; 0 no improvement; empty unobserved

variables.name: self_report_improvement
variables.role: complete secondary outcome using a different measurement process

hidden_generator_parameters.primary_control_risk_and_risk_difference: recorded in scripts/generate_unit9.py and the verified result; not analyst evidence
hidden_generator_parameters.observation: probability depends only on assignment, site, and baseline_high_distress

target_population: fixed external site-by-distress shares recorded in the verified result; no target-person microdata are included
